web.description: Elastic Security Labs has documented four previously unreported programs associated with REVSTEALER, an emerging Windows information stealer, that remain on an infected machine after the stealer deletes itself.   One of them switches off Windows Update and Microsoft Defender before running a cryptocurrency miner.   The company named the four programs ProManager , WinUpdate , SoftManager , and LockAppHost  and  published the findings on September 2 , along with a  technical white paper .
